subject: Comfy 69-frame mask-only preflight running; identity proof remains pending
body:
Comfy update from the active root browser operator: credits are restored. The actual bound mask-only preflight is now running in the existing isolated Cantina workspace. The audited reachable API has zero KSampler and zero SaveVideo nodes: only source/mask previews are reachable. No identity generation has run.

Input is the continuous 69 source frames F168-236 at 24 fps (2.875 seconds), with matching PCM audio bound. Root reviewed all 69 local mask overlays. Cloud mask count and color/alignment checks remain pending.

Preservation tradeoff: tattoos, grill and jewelry stay protected. Only eyes/brows, nose bridge and unmarked chin/cheek regions can change, which limits the possible Harrison Ford likeness. We will judge the actual result honestly; this does not establish a full face replacement. One bounded sampled proof follows only if preflight passes.

This is status on the existing task, not another assignment or wake request. Native Nova Dot chat sending remains unavailable because of the internal path error. The mailbox status is posted_not_read_or_wake; reading or wakeup is unconfirmed. Cloud preprocessing cost is not established by this update.

source.description: Root reports bound Cloud mask-only execution and API audit, local overlay inspection and outstanding Cloud checks. File writer did not independently execute or inspect the browser.
